esm.note: THREE injected only via CF.init({THREE}); no window.THREE fallback

generator.deterministic: same seed + profileEntry + generatorVersion -> same recipe (and recipeHash) within api major 1

optionalBones.note: shared rig 24->29 joints: unused, non-deforming for races without a tail / wings (no vertex weights on them outside Tail_* nodes); Idle/Walk clips have no tracks on them. Tail sway is code (tail block).

richness.note: richness biases dye saturation/value (x0.55..1.25), trim regions (trim/buttons/emblem/band/frame) go gold >=0.7 and drab <0.3; regalia garments/styles/races are only generated at richness >= regalia.minRichness

edit.note: Recipe-edit data for creator UIs (offline). CF.options(race,gender,{age}) = options[race][gender][age] expanded with catalog display data. Compact form: sliders {id:[min,max,default]} (group: catalog.sliderGroups, step catalog.sliderStep); garments per slot: catalog.slotsByAge[age] (same for every race). Patch shape: CF.describe(recipe). Generated by test/edit_snapshot.mjs.

notes.headwear: styles[id].headwear[gid] = hair state the style takes under that garment (default garment states; rules MAN.rules hairStates). Any style may be worn with any headwear; while a hat state is active hairLength/bangLength are clamped <=0 at render (recipe values kept).
notes.hairColors: deniedSkins: skins this ramp is rejected on (hue too close). stylised ramps are race-gated.
notes.facePresets: face presets: 'race' = the race/gender preset face (viewer setPreset); 'p1'..'pN' = deterministic faces from the generator's own face stream for this race/gender.
notes.slotRegions: catalog.slotRegions.upper/lower partition catalog.slots at legs (order preserved). Visual coverage is not slot occupation.
notes.occupation: garments[id].occupation = [{when,slots}] from merged-engine slotsOf over every state combo; when lists only states that change homes. Exactly one row matches a complete selection.

child.note: profileEntry.ages {adult:w,child:w} (default adult only). A child is the race body through a per-race modifier (recipe.age='child'; recipe.S stays the adult sliders); same rig / bones. Adult-only items are never generated for a child and are dropped (substitute applied) when a child recipe is loaded.
